subject: Code review: Changes requested for AMSD-2041

body.text: Code review identified issues that need to be addressed.

issues.description: findSingletonEntry destructures { contentTypeUid, lang, referenceFieldPath, jsonRtePath, only, except, where } but does NOT destructure or forward `live_preview` to createContentTypeQuery. Since IContentstackGetSingletonEntry extends ICommonContentstackConfig (which now has live_preview), callers can pass live_preview but it is silently dropped. This means linked/tabular references fetched via findSingletonEntry will not show draft values, partially undermining the story's core goal.
issues.suggestedFix: Add `live_preview` to the destructured params of findSingletonEntry and pass it to createContentTypeQuery: `createContentTypeQuery({ contentTypeUid, referenceFieldPath, only, except, where, lang, limit: 1, live_preview })`.

issues.description: getSingletonEntry has the same gap as findSingletonEntry — it destructures { contentTypeUid, lang, referenceFieldPath, jsonRtePath, only, except, where } but does NOT destructure or forward `live_preview` to createContentTypeQuery. Draft preview context is silently dropped for this code path.
issues.suggestedFix: Add `live_preview` to the destructured params of getSingletonEntry and pass it to createContentTypeQuery: `createContentTypeQuery({ contentTypeUid, referenceFieldPath, only, except, where, lang, live_preview })`.
